description:
As a customer, I want to change my cart before checking out.

* Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
* Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
* Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
* Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

criteria.text: Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

cases.title: Increasing an item's quantity updates the line total and the cart total
cases.preconditions: Logged in as <a customer account>. The cart contains <an item with a known unit price> at quantity 1. Note the line total and the cart total before the change.
steps: Open the cart page.
Record the item's line total and the cart total.
Increase the quantity of the item from 1 to 2.
cases.expected: The item's line total updates to reflect the new quantity, and the cart total updates accordingly.

cases.title: Increasing the quantity of one item in a multi-item cart updates that line and the cart total
cases.preconditions: Logged in as <a customer account>. The cart contains <two different items, each with a known unit price>. Note each line total and the cart total before the change.
steps: Open the cart page.
Record both line totals and the cart total.
Increase the quantity of the first item by 1.
Check the first item's line total.
Check the second item's line total.
Check the cart total.
cases.expected: The first item's line total updates for the new quantity, the second item's line total is unchanged, and the cart total updates accordingly.

cases.title: Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total
cases.preconditions: Logged in as <a customer account>. The cart contains <two different items, each with a known unit price>. Note the cart total before the change.
steps: Open the cart page.
Record the cart total and the items listed.
Remove the first item from the cart.
cases.expected: The removed item no longer appears in the cart list, the other item is still listed, and the cart total updates to reflect the removal.

cases.title: Removing the last item shows an empty cart message
cases.preconditions: Logged in as <a customer account>. The cart contains exactly one item: <any purchasable item>.
steps: Open the cart page.
Remove the only item from the cart.
cases.expected: The item no longer appears in the cart list and an empty cart message is shown (the exact message text is not specified in the story).

cases.title: Cart contents persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: Logged in as <a customer account>. The cart contains <two different items, each with a known unit price>.
steps: Open the cart page.
Record the items listed, their quantities, the line totals and the cart total.
Refresh the page in the browser.
Compare the cart contents with what was recorded.
cases.expected: After the refresh the cart shows the same items, quantities, line totals and cart total as before the refresh.

cases.title: Changes made to the cart persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: Logged in as <a customer account>. The cart contains <two different items, each with a known unit price>, each at quantity 1.
steps: Open the cart page.
Increase the quantity of the first item from 1 to 2.
Remove the second item from the cart.
Record the items listed, their quantities, the line totals and the cart total.
Refresh the page in the browser.
cases.expected: After the refresh the cart still shows only the first item at quantity 2, with the same line total and cart total recorded before the refresh; the removed item is still absent.
